text:
deploybot: Automatic pause: rollout v2.16.0 slot 3 quarantined after repeated 502/503s observed from eu-control-plane. Quarantine engaged at 18:24 UTC.
samira: ack. what's the scope? which zones and percent of traffic?
leo: errors concentrated in eu-west and eu-north, ~7% of total traffic, spikes coincide with a DB replica failover. traces show token fetch retries amplifying.
ops-oncall: confirming — control-plane retries spiked during replica re-election. looks like transient upstream DB instability, not code change. ETA for stabilization 40m.
release-manager: do NOT trigger an automatic rollback. pin the release to avoid partial rollout and annotate with incident. we'll plan a micro-canary once ops clears.
deploy-admin: pinning now: `deployctl pin --svc inference-api --ver v2.16.0 --slot 3 --note "hold/INC-8610 db-failover"`
deploybot: Pin recorded. Slot 3 quarantined; subsequent slots paused and queued. Canary traffic diverted to last-known-good variant.
platform-eng: creating a hotfix branch just in case: `hotfix/db-connection-backoff-2026-03-21`. prepping quick rollback playbook.
leo: preparing rollback command for SRE standby:
```
# rollback to stable v2.15.14
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.16.0 --to-version v2.15.14 --reason "INC-8610"
```
ops-oncall: mitigation in progress on DB side; electing new replica and increasing connection timeouts. monitoring shows error rate decreasing over last 10m.
release-manager: proposed plan: keep pin, do NOT unquarantine slot 3 automatically. reschedule remaining slots to maintenance window 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC and run a 2% micro-canary at 00:00 UTC for early verification. post-canary we either resume or rollback according to metrics.
samira: sounds good. I'll own micro-canary smoke tests and report latency/error deltas here.
deploy-admin: annotated deploy ticket with reschedule and added tag `hold/INC-8610`. next retry for slot 4 moved to 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z (2% micro-canary).
incident-bot: INC-8610 updated: DB replica re-election detected; mitigation applied; monitoring for regressions. next update in 15m.
platform-eng: hotfix branch pushed and a config toggle ready if we need to backoff connections at runtime. dry-run passed in staging.
leo: if ops confirms DB not related to our runtime, we'll proceed with micro-canary and then full window resume. if metrics show app-level errors, execute rollback command above.
release-manager: I'll update the release doc and status page with a short note: cause hypothesis, pin action, reschedule and micro-canary plan, rollback readiness. customer comms queued if window shift impacts customers.
samira: added checklist to release doc: pin, rollback ready, hotfix branch, micro-canary owner, customer notice owner. assigning to @deploy-admin and @samira.
deploybot: Noted. Rollout remains paused for slot 3; next scheduled attempt for slot 4 moved to 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z (2% micro-canary).
ops-oncall: DB metrics look stable. recommend keeping pin and proceeding with micro-canary at 00:00 UTC per plan. we will provide final go/no-go 15m before canary.
release-manager: agreed. final signoff required in this thread before any rollback action. reconvene 23:45 UTC for go/no-go. :eyes:
